title: Adversary ratio with neutral prompts: 1/6, 2/6, 4/6 liars

notes: Codex: 'Four of six adversaries is too extreme to be the paper's primary result.'
Tests 1, 2, and 4 adversaries with neutral honest-agent prompts.
If contagion only appears at 4/6, the paper's result depends on adversary ratio.
If it appears at 1/6 or 2/6, the finding is more robust.
